heroSummary: Jeffco Public Schools students begin the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, August 18, 2027, and finish Thursday, May 25, 2028. calendarNotes: Jeffco lists 79 first-semester and 92 second-semester student contact days, for 171 total, alongside 88 and 97 teacher workdays, for 185 total. February 18 and March 27 are teacher staff-development dates that may become snow make-up days. Winter Break ends January 4, so students return January 5. Spring Break ends March 24, but March 27 remains conditional: students attend that day only if Jeffco uses it for snow make-up. The PDF says additional modified contact days appear on individual school calendars. Unlike the 2026–27 PDF, this version does not publish a 2.5-hour early-dismissal notice for the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Jeffco Public Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for students on Jeffco's district family calendar is Wednesday, August 18, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Jeffco Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs through Tuesday, January 4, 2028, so students return Wednesday, January 5. January 3–4 are also listed for teacher staff development.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Jeffco Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Jeffco Spring Break runs Monday, March 20 through Friday, March 24, 2028. March 27 is a conditional snow make-up date: students return that day only if Jeffco uses it for snow make-up; otherwise they return Tuesday, March 28.

calendarFaqs.q: Which dates may become Jeffco snow make-up days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Jeffco lists February 18 and March 27 as potential snow make-up days. They are otherwise teacher staff-development days, so families should wait for district confirmation before relying on them as days off.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Jeffco in 2028, and is it an early-dismissal day?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 25, 2028. The published 2027–28 family calendar does not include a districtwide early-dismissal notice, so families should check their school for dismissal times and Modified Contact Day information.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this page include every Jeffco modified contact day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Jeffco says additional Modified Contact Days are identified on individual school calendars. Because 2027–28 is still a future school year, families should also recheck the district calendar before making plans.

customSections.content: This page follows Jeffco's districtwide Family Calendar for first and last days, breaks, legal holidays, teacher staff-development days and potential snow make-up dates. customSections.label: How Jeffco's 2027–28 Snow Make-Up Dates Work
